name: hypothyroidism due to TSH receptor mutations
description: Hypothyroidism due to thyroid-stimulating hormone (TSH) receptor mutations is a type of primary congenital hypothyroidism, a permanent thyroid hormone deficiency that is present from birth due to thyroid resistance to TSH.
